exact_source_statement.source_quote: Improve the fluctuation exponent in directed polymers.
exact_source_statement.scoped_model: Zero-temperature 1+1-dimensional up/right paths of n vertices from the origin in Z_+^2, free endpoint, iid standard Gaussian site weights; M_n is the maximal sum of weights over paths.
exact_source_statement.existing_bound: Theorem 8.1: Var(M_n) <= C n/log n for a universal C.
exact_source_statement.proposed_quantification: Find epsilon>0 and C_epsilon<infinity with Var(M_n) <= C_epsilon n^(1-epsilon) for all sufficiently large n in the Section 8 model. This quantification is an interpretation of the source's open prompt, not its verbatim statement.
